# Is my S corporation loss deductible, and is that distribution tax free?

> Free S corporation shareholder basis calculator. Enter each year's K-1 figures and get stock basis, debt basis and suspended losses carried forward in Form 7203 order, with taxable excess distributions flagged. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
